fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: A thrown barrel that deals 45 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and bursts for 80% damage on enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Undertow
fusions.desc: Drags a line of current 6 tiles long for 6 seconds. It deals 9 damage to each enemy that crosses it and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Gull on the Mast
fusions.desc: A bonded gull circles above you and strikes an enemy within 6 tiles for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.
